description: Selecting high 63-day momentum stocks (skipping 21 days) with the lowest 252-day realized volatility targets the 'low-vol anomaly' within momentum, yielding better risk-adjusted returns; falsified if the volatility filter does not improve forward Sharpe relative to unfiltered 63-day momentum.
title: Low Vol Momentum 63d Skip 21 Top 50 Top500 Long Only
